rappel_detail.station: The top of the South Chimney, at the summit of the Middle Peak.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 1 of 2, about 60 ft, down the South Chimney.

rappel_detail.station: Partway down the South Chimney, at the end of the first rappel.
rappel_detail.notes: Rappel 2 of 2, about 60 ft, to the south-facing ledge below the rock gable. Then traverse back toward the Main-Middle notch and descend the talus.
